newsitem.title: USA: Ashland raises bid for Melamine.
newsitem.headline: Ashland raises bid for Melamine.

text.p: Ashland Inc has sweetened its unsolicited takeover bid for Melamine Chemials Inc to $14.75 a share from $12.50, Melamine said Friday.
Ashland, one of Melamine's principal stockholders, notified the company of the higher bid in an August 14 letter to Melamine Chairman James Crook from Ashland Chairman Paul Chellgren.
In a statement, Melamine said it will respond to Ashland's latest bid "in due course."

Ashland, an energy and chemicals concern, already owns a stake of about 23 percent in Melamine, one of two producers of the chemical melamine in North America. The chemical is used in adhesives, laminates, paints and other products.
Melamine hired Goldman, Sachs & Co as its financial adviser after receiving Ashland's initial offer.
